limits: Read-only hashing/static inspection only. No imports of author code, tests, helpers, producers, native engine, guard, fixtures, network, git mutation.
preliminaryReasoning: Original HOST-API:10 requires source causal pre-Save capture and host ordering proof, not literal host disk commit before Save; R06 correction is textually supported.
Native GetPlayerID returns int or -1 when no game; native GetEngineInfo constructs full four-key ordered mods with engine_version and deep freeze. Frozen result does not prove caller/body/provenance.
GuiInterfaceCall uses actual viewed player, simulation realm invocation and clone back; literal principal and payload principal cannot replace that boundary.

SaveGame returns void; GUI metadata structured clone precedes SavedGames::Save; SerializeState precedes attrs/mods/player/camera metadata collection. Paused same callback does not prove absence of serializer/prototype/group/camera mutations.
Design keeps complete init transformations OPEN as future SOURCE admission gate, does not learn unknown getter keys into expected; this is not by itself a design blocker.
